name: Night Shapes
description: An original festival concept with performer imagery, a day-and-stage programme, overlap-aware personal schedule, and an illustrative pass calculator.

notes.layout: wide condensed title, full-width concert photography, asymmetric artist lineup, day-filtered programme, personal schedule
notes.motion: pausable lineup ticker, staggered title arrivals, programme-state transitions, reduced-motion support
notes.interaction: filter sets by day, stage and artist, save a personal schedule, detect overlaps, estimate concept passes and export a calendar
notes.provenance: Original six-page event concept with its own visual direction, performer images, programme data, and local planner. All artists, dates, stages and prices are fictional; no reference code or assets included.
